title: When People are Floods: Analyzing Dehumanizing Metaphors in Immigration Discourse with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper develops and evaluates an LLM-based approach for detecting dehumanizing metaphors in immigration discourse. While it includes an 'Ethical Implications' section regarding the study of offensive content and dehumanization, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/theological systems as a core component of its research.
